lithos_version: lithos 0.5.0 @ a4d2d62 (source read 2026-10-04); every envelope below is the source's, and each was also probed against a newer live Lithos (MCP serverInfo 3.2.0) — differences are recorded in observed_divergences, never substituted

canonical.reason: superseded by the new ingest path

request.notes: Applies ONLY to an `open` task and answers the SAME `task_not_found` code for a missing task and for a task that is not open, exactly as complete does. Releases every claim on the task. Does NOT cascade to children. `reason` is optional and reaches the log and the `task.cancelled` event payload ONLY — it is not stored on the task row (ROADMAP ledger #6), which is why the cancel form labels it that way. Every id goes through the SHARED resolver (`resolve_task_id`): a value of 36 or more characters is a full id and passes through untouched, a miss included, to this tool's own lookup; anything shorter than `MIN_PREFIX_LEN` (6) is `invalid_input`; anything between is searched as a PREFIX — matching nothing is the resolver's own `task_not_found` ("No task matches id prefix …", a different message from this tool's own not-found, same code) and matching several is `ambiguous_id_prefix` (`AmbiguousIdPrefixError`, mapped by `tool_span`) with up to `AMBIGUITY_CANDIDATE_CAP` (5) `{id, title}` candidate RECORDS, the message stating the capped count. Every envelope is `{status, code, message}` plus, for that one code, `candidates` — the coordination errors here carry no other key. Lens sends a full id for this tool (the funnel acts on a task it has just read), so none of the prefix refusals is on a Lens request; all are vendored because the mapper must still answer them.

errors.message: Task influx-backfill not found or already closed
task_id 'infl' is too short: pass the full task id or a prefix of at least 6 characters.
Task id prefix '506155' (task_id) is ambiguous: 2 or more matches. Retry with a longer prefix or a full id from candidates.

observed_divergences: None in shape. The success payload is the tool's return dict verbatim (`{success, task_id, title, updated_at}`) and says nothing about consequences: the dependents a cancel strands (`blocker_unsatisfiable`), the claims it released and the gate waiters it makes unsatisfiable are all absent, so Lens states them from its own bounded downstream walk BEFORE the call (T3 D9). The `task_not_found` text is cancel's own and is worded differently from complete's ("not found or already closed", the id unquoted) — same code, two texts, which is why Lens matches on the code. `reason` reaches only the log line and the `task.cancelled` event: `cancel_task` writes status, resolved_at and updated_at and nothing else. The success payload itself is not probed live: it would cancel a real task. Live check: the envelopes and order above were also probed (2026-10-04) against the Lithos this environment reaches, serverInfo 3.2.0 — NEWER than a4d2d62 (it serves `lithos_task_edge_delete`, added after 0.5.0) — with requests the server refuses, so nothing was written.
